auto_note_prefixes: A LEFT JOIN keeps every record
A RIGHT JOIN keeps every record
An INNER JOIN keeps only records
A FULL OUTER JOIN keeps every record
A FULL OUTER JOIN keeps records
A UNION stacks records from file
This step stacks records from two files
This step combines records from two files

join.LEFT JOIN: A LEFT JOIN keeps every record from file 1 ({left_alias}) and adds matching details from file 2 ({right_alias}) when a match is found. Rows in file 2 ({right_alias}) will not be kept if the keys {keys} do not match. As a result, rows from file 1 ({left_alias}) may contain NULL values if no match is found in file 2 ({right_alias}).
join.RIGHT JOIN: A RIGHT JOIN keeps every record from file 2 ({right_alias}) and adds matching details from file 1 ({left_alias}) when a match is found. Rows in file 1 ({left_alias}) will not be kept if the keys {keys} do not match. As a result, rows from file 2 ({right_alias}) may contain NULL values if no match is found in file 1 ({left_alias}).
join.INNER JOIN: An INNER JOIN keeps only records where file 1 ({left_alias}) and file 2 ({right_alias}) both have matching keys {keys}. Rows from either file will not be kept if the keys do not match.
join.FULL OUTER JOIN: A FULL OUTER JOIN keeps every record from file 1 ({left_alias}) and every record from file 2 ({right_alias}). Matching records are combined when the keys {keys} match. As a result, rows from either file may contain NULL values for the other file columns if no match is found.
join.DEFAULT: This join compares file 1 ({left_alias}) to file 2 ({right_alias}) using keys {keys}.

notes.union: A UNION stacks records from file 1 ({left_source}) and file 2 ({right_source}) into one combined file ({output_source}). Records are not matched on keys; the rows from both files are kept together in the combined output. Use this when both files represent the same type of record and should be reviewed together.
